summary: Extracted testable Swagger/OpenAPI integration requirements for Story 2 from the story and existing API implementation; no required clarification is unresolved.

decisions.requirement: Provide Swagger UI at /swagger-ui/index.html and OpenAPI JSON at /v3/api-docs.
Document GET /api/employees, GET /api/employees/{id}, and POST /api/employees; do not add business endpoints.
Expose Employee fields id, name, email and CreateEmployeeRequest fields name, email in request/response schemas.
Document existing responses: GET collection 200; GET by ID 200 and 404; POST 201 and 400.
Keep existing API behavior unchanged and ensure existing tests continue to pass.
Add minimal verification that Swagger UI and OpenAPI JSON are available.
Update API documentation only as needed for this integration.
decisions.source: docs/story2.md AC9; existing API documentation: docs/api-docs.md

decisions.requirement: Use the existing Spring Boot project and a springdoc-openapi dependency compatible with it.
Make no database or authentication changes and avoid unnecessary refactoring.

decisions.criterion: GET /v3/api-docs is accessible and returns OpenAPI JSON.
OpenAPI documents all three specified routes and their existing response codes and Employee/CreateEmployeeRequest fields.
